faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our mechanical models

questions.question: What sets do I need to build these models?
questions.answer: Each model includes a detailed parts list specifying the exact sets needed. Most builds use Technic and Creator sets, which are listed on each product page.

questions.question: Are the instructions included with purchase?
questions.answer: Yes, every purchase includes comprehensive digital PDF instructions with step-by-step building guides, parts inventory, and assembly tips.

questions.question: What skill level do I need?
questions.answer: We offer models for all skill levels, from beginner to expert. Each product clearly indicates its complexity level and estimated build time.

questions.question: Can I request custom modifications?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Contact us for custom build requests. We can modify existing designs or create entirely new models based on your specifications.

questions.question: What format are the instructions in?
questions.answer: Instructions are delivered as high-resolution PDF files that can be viewed on any device. Some complex builds also include 3D viewer files.
